q1.question: How much does it cost to place an order?
q1.answer: Placing an order on the platform is absolutely free. You don't pay any commission when creating a request.

q2.question: What is the platform commission?
q2.answer: Platform commission is 10% of the deal amount and is charged from the master after successful order completion.

q3.question: How does payment work?
q3.answer: Customer makes prepayment to platform account. Money is frozen and transferred to master only after work acceptance.

q4.question: What to do in case of dispute?
q4.answer: Contact support service in case of dispute. We will review the situation and make a fair decision within 48 hours.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to popular questions about platform operation

q1.question: How is commission calculated?
q1.answer: Commission depends on order amount: up to 100,000 ₸ — 10%, from 100,000 to 500,000 ₸ — 7%, over 500,000 ₸ — 5%. Commission is deducted only after successful order completion and work approval by client.

q2.question: When does the master receive money?
q2.answer: After the client accepts the work and confirms order completion, money is automatically transferred to the master minus commission. Withdrawal available within 24 hours.

q3.question: How does secure transaction work?
q3.answer: Client makes prepayment to ALLIANCE protected account. Master sees that money is reserved and starts work. After work acceptance by client, funds are transferred to master.

q4.question: What to do in case of dispute between client and master?
q4.answer: In case of dispute, contact support service. Our specialists will review the situation and help find a fair solution. Until dispute resolution, money remains in protected account.

q5.question: Are there paid features for masters?
q5.answer: Basic functionality is completely free. In the future, optional PRO features for profile promotion are planned, but the main service will remain free.

q6.question: How is order payment made?
q6.answer: Client can pay with Visa/Mastercard bank card or through Kaspi. For legal entities, non-cash payment by invoice is available.
